'''Titroxinate''' was a potent [[Neurotoxin/Legends|neurotoxin]], used as a biological weapon by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Use of Titroxinate was also one of the many methods of [[Torture/Legends|torture]] employed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
